purpose.en: Build the back of the upper arms.

text.zh: 俯身背部平直，大臂不动，向后伸直手肘
text.en: Hinge with a flat back, keep your upper arms still, and straighten your elbows

text.zh: 膝盖微屈，躯干保持稳定
text.en: Keep your knees soft and your trunk steady.

text.zh: 伸直后停一下，再慢慢弯回
text.en: Pause with arms straight, then bend back slowly.

cautions.zh: 用轻重量，先做 1 组轻松的 6 次
cautions.en: Use light weights and start with one easy set of 6 reps.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
